entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for user, session, and agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, SDK, or managed cloud.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This memory system enables long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers. It provides client libraries for Python, Node.js, and Go, with deployment options ranging from CLI and Docker to managed cloud.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading architecture (Abstract, Overview, Details) to achieve significant token reduction and improved task completion rates.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: A self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It builds searchable graphs from text, code, and conversations and can run locally on a CPU without external LLM API keys.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine that sustains sub-300ms recall at high volumes. It supports multi-modal extraction and maintains auto-updated user profiles with context fencing and byte-level deduplication.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance, allowing for corrections and withdrawals of stored information. It includes a synthesis layer for cited answers and exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: The upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper, designed for building stateful agents via a FastAPI server. It tracks peer-centric representations and session context through background reasoning using Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages a plain markdown context tree using git-like version control features such as branching and merging. It offers a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms performance and an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10+ and a single SQLite database. It delivers sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression to manage storage growth at scale.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: This system extracts durable knowledge from ephemeral conversation streams and reconciles conflicting information by superseding old beliefs. It allows for the export of memory estates as plain Markdown via the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent that utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that generates playbooks and training artifacts from task runs to assist agents with complex tasks. It supports various LLM endpoints and provides entry points via CLI, MCP server, and Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin utilizes a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure message persistence without data loss. It provides specific recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help Hermes Agent recover specific details from its context history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It tracks file edits and command statuses locally, allowing users to search through months of past sessions.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports various OpenAI-compatible LLM providers and local inference servers for persistent data storage.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first identity and memory layer offers portable state across multiple clients and supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It demonstrates high performance on LongMemEval benchmarks for accurate information retrieval.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer stores information as human-readable YAML engrams on local disk for use across multiple coding agents. It employs local-first retrieval methods, including BGE-small and optional rerankers, to manage agent context.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: Operating entirely locally without cloud dependencies, this engine captures agent decisions and preferences from session transcripts. It retrieves information by fusing BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal techniques.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This five-package plugin family provides durable, file-based long-term memory using a SQLite-backed hierarchical schema and FTS5 search. It is designed to function without vector databases or embedding models across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This tool optimizes long context inference by reordering text and multimodal data to facilitate prefix-cache sharing. It integrates with various inference engines to provide cache-aware scheduling and context deduplication.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded in-process backend provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled item with a reason for its selection. It features built-in primitives for tracking contradictions and resolving conflicts within the agent's memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless system uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files. It utilizes a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI tool allows agents to autonomously maintain and evolve persistent knowledge stored in local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team synchronization through a self-hosted server with integrated permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This MCP-native server uses an anticipatory cache to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It relies on local-first storage via SQLite-vec and processes GGUF models to manage memory for coding agents.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner to manage state and retrieval via SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma. It provides the agent with a purpose-built evidence packet for each query to streamline information processing.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory for agents using semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia with OCR support, utilizing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This project reduces prompt token overhead for Hermes Agent v0.14.0 by using local BM25 tool ranking to select relevant keyword-based schemas. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and supports native tool search functionality.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: Agent Context OS serves as a Git-backed context and workflow layer for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It uses a migration workflow to convert chats and documents into reviewable files, requiring manual approval for context proposals and integration.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories through 1-10 importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction for structured memory management.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This pull-model episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking every memory operation. It distinguishes itself by supporting real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to provide concise system-prompt hints via session hooks. It offers five native tools for artifact search, retrieval, and feedback to improve agent routing capabilities.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail provides a TypeScript SDK and MCP server that enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing for budget-bound agent wallets.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo enables cross-session continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected agents through native lifecycle hooks. It utilizes a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability during pre-turn recall and session-end snapshots.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory, providing tools for both manual storage and automated searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to refine the retrieval process for the agent.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: SourceVault provides private local code memory for repositories, supporting semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for indexing, syncing, and reading files.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports retrieval via HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index methods. It can be executed through native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency through automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation loop identifies 'rot' and contradictions within markdown files to propose evidence-cited JSON diffs for review. It functions without a database, instead leveraging a local git repository to track, manage, and revert changes to the agent's memory.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while emphasizing TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured software development methodology for agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system that enables Hermes Agent to generate web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts via a dedicated CLI. It supports exports to formats like HTML, PDF, and MP4 while integrating with the DeepSeek Harness for native runtime support.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent capabilities in cybersecurity and risk management.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill allows agents to convert codebases, schemas, and natural language descriptions into draw.io diagrams. It includes a CLI and MCP server that support incremental synchronization while preserving manual layout adjustments.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It functions as a master router that includes escrow and dispute resolution layers for secure transactions.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using professional, technical, or casual voice profiles. It is compatible with agentskills.io agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, for detect-only or edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies skill libraries across devices and teams while automating quality improvement through background evolution and deduplication. It integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs to allow agentic skills to evolve collectively.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within a project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other compatible agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 1,176 markdown-based skills across 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring telemetry or user accounts. It provides ready-to-paste exports for broad compatibility with assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, providing slash commands for managing and saving new skills.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: These skills teach Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. The system includes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It features a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically synchronizes source code edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow skill converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It ensures quality via a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills while managing event logging.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. Users can install these localized skills via a CLI tap or direct raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with oracle networks including CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These developer tools are installed through the Vercel CLI for open skills.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides eight specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation prompting. It integrates with the BFL API to support polling, webhooks, and advanced video generation workflows.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts code repositories and documentation into verified instruction files compliant with the agentskills.io specification. It features automated workflows to brief, create, test, and export skills mapped to specific source lines.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Rust-based workflow language converts plain-text job descriptions into .nika files using a four-verb syntax. It audits tool permissions and costs before execution and generates hash-chained records to verify run integrity.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification, accessible via a Python client or CLI. It supports recursive dependency resolution during installation and includes commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex multi-step tasks with autonomous execution and real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for task recovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords, featuring a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community hub for browsing, searching, and installing skills using the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye utilizes a five-layer retrieval system, including hard triggers and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. This approach reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models or dependencies are unavailable.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client employs a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It uses a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incrementally discovers server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system that integrates Hermes Agent via MCP for agent-driven scheduling and habit management. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard provides adversarial code review by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Go, and Rust. It employs a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates for grounded task execution. It includes a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and a Python goal engine for persistent state management.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. it integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files. It integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration for agents like Claude Code and Cursor. They are installed as drop-in markdown files and include a bundled installer for managing updates and drift checks.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It ensures data privacy through read-only access and local log desensitization while offering optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal interfaces and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose coverage gaps in agent skills. It gates all updates behind a multi-stage evaluation framework involving deterministic and LLM-judge tests without requiring external services.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills and Claude Code extensions while monitoring official specifications to prevent field drift. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with specific runtime profiles.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and lead generation across platforms like Claude Code and Cursor. It includes an MCP server to facilitate browser-based OAuth authentication for these workflows.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR via macOS Vision, and removing common Chinese AI writing patterns. It is designed to transform media and documents into structured Markdown or subtitles for e-commerce and content workflows.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like x402 and MPP. It is compatible with the agentskills.io standard and provides a bridge for agents to handle financial transactions autonomously.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill works as intended.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties or managing their own bounty boards. It operates over x402 without requiring accounts or API keys, utilizing user-defined price ceilings for automated payments.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides structured web data access across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 different tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global events to street-level updates. It produces structured reports featuring core conclusions and action suggestions while utilizing semantic memory to align search expansions with specific user interests.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes and other coding agents through pre-indexed project data. It features automated background synchronization and auto-configures as an MCP server to streamline agent integration.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility designed to track token consumption across multiple AI agents, including Hermes and Claude Code. It offers a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard, allowing developers to monitor usage and submit data to public leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting sensitive authentication headers. It exports sessions into self-contained HTML viewers for detailed analysis of agent communication.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and 40+ other AI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization to provide historical usage breakdowns across different machines and projects.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates directly with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that loads 36 skills and 6 specialized roles into Hermes Agent to coordinate a 'CTO loop' for application development. It automates the entire lifecycle from building to operating apps, including health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This community-driven project allows for the customization of the Hermes terminal UI using YAML-based themes. Users can modify banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art to achieve aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control that supports external MCP clients and browser automation. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with @handles. It enables Hermes agents to engage in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, eliminating the need for external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM inference, GGUF, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that uses HERM v1.1 scoring to identify ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions. It supports MCP and function-tool definitions, generating SARIF and JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms and development environments, including VS Code and Slack.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup integrates RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It features over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by an automated cross-platform installer for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories, tools, and instructions. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration of the directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of a hermes-agent stack along with 12 supporting services and 29 community plugins. It offers three scalable deployment tiers, ranging from a minimum viable setup to a full production stack, at zero cost using free models.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems via a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It utilizes zero-token passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift against config-aware baselines.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime operations, this tool functions as a deterministic, zero-network environment for executing financial opportunities. It enforces a strict security model requiring explicit user approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds offline voice capabilities to Hermes Agent, supporting 35 languages and featuring adaptive turn-taking with barge-in functionality. It operates entirely locally without the need for API keys, accounts, or external service dependencies.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes enables multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities for agent data. It includes built-in tools for managing memories and a circuit breaker to handle potential MemOS API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager supports Windows, macOS, and Linux for handling Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI. It streamlines the user experience by enabling one-click switching between different API providers and managing their respective configurations.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that facilitates autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for Hermes Agent and other CLIs. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and supports 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on web browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JS, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and dependency resolution. It provides a GUI for chat, session management, and tool configuration across multiple AI providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and local endpoints.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko-studio is a web dashboard that offers unified configuration for Hermes Agent across ten platforms, including Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp. It supports visual workflows with human approval gates and provides detailed usage analytics for token and cost tracking.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, PTY terminal, memory browser, and an MCP catalog for comprehensive agent management.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and fourteen other built-in agents as a desktop or self-hosted app. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app features a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside standard chat and memory management tools.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects the active browser context to local, cloud, or self-hosted Hermes Agent runtimes. It provides site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments and tools for tab triage and multi-agent switching.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app designed to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables mobile management of tasks and file systems while supporting real-time chat streaming with tool-call details.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines like Claude Code and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This terminal-based consciousness monitor provides an interactive TUI with nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and monitoring scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard features a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines and agent health. It serves as a control plane for managing MCP server lifecycles and provides real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that searches local agent histories and tracks per-session quota burn without uploading data. It allows users to resume supported CLI sessions directly in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp while monitoring estimated API-equivalent costs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for communication with cloud-hosted agents.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based Telegram Mini App provides a mobile-first UI capable of spawning five concurrent background agent instances. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses and implements dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via contained Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It features a built-in workflow engine and 100 tools covering TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI image creation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring a chat-first interface with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for handling separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a native interface. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
